questions.question: In the following question, correct the equation by interchanging two signs. 4 – 10 × 5 + 9 ÷ 3 = 51
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, correct the equation by interchanging two signs.

4 – 10 × 5 + 9 ÷ 3 = 51
questions.solution:
Option 1) × and -

→ 4 × 10 - 5 + 9 ÷ 3 = 51

→ 4 × 10 - 5 + 3 = 51

→ 40 - 5 + 3 = 51

→ 38 ≠ 51

Option 2) ÷ and ×

→ 4 - 10 ÷ 5 + 9 × 3 = 51

→ 4 - 2 + 9 × 3 = 51

→ 4 - 2 + 27 = 51

→ 29 ≠ 51

Option 3) + and -

→ 4 + 10 × 5 - 9 ÷ 3 = 51

→ 4 + 10 × 5 - 3 = 51

→ 4 + 50 - 3 = 51

→ 54 - 3 = 51

→ 51 = 51

Option 4) - and ÷

→ 4 ÷ 10 × 5 + 9 - 3 = 51

→ 0.4 × 5 + 9 - 3 = 51

→ 2 + 9 - 3 = 51

→ 8 ≠ 51

Hence, we’ll interchange ‘+ and -’ to get the correct equation.

questions.question: Which among the following is not an instrument of fiscal policy?
questions.questionHtml: Which among the following is not an instrument of fiscal policy?
questions.solution: Fiscal policy is the use of government spending, taxation, and transfer payments to influence aggregate demand. The major instruments of fiscal policy include the budget, taxation, public expenditure, public works, and public debt. The budget involves planning government spending and revenue. Taxation involves collecting taxes from citizens and businesses. Public expenditure includes government spending on goods and services. Public works involve government-funded construction projects. Public debt involves borrowing money to finance government spending. These instruments are used to stimulate or slow down the economy, depending on the prevailing economic conditions.

questions.question: When a ball is thrown vertically upwards, which of the following quantities remains constant during its motion?
questions.questionHtml: When a ball is thrown vertically upwards, which of the following quantities remains constant during its motion?
questions.solution:
CONCEPT:

  • The capacity to do work is called energy.
  • According to the energy conservation principle, the total energy of the system always remains constant.
  • Kinetic energy: The energy of a body due to its motion is called kinetic energy.
  • Potential energy: The energy of a body due to its position is called potential energy.
  • The total energy is the sum of kinetic energy and potential energy.

EXPLANATION:

  • When a ball is thrown vertically upwards, the kinetic energy of the ball converted into potential energy of the ball. But the total energy of the ball remains constant during its motion. So option 1 is correct.
  • It is because at the beginning the ball has high kinetic energy and no potential energy. As it moves up its kinetic energy gets converted to potential energy. At the peak its kinetic energy is nil and it has the highest potential energy.
  • From now onwards its potential energy begins to convert into kinetic energy as it falls to the ground. 
  • As the ball goes in the upward direction, the displacement, and velocity changes. When the velocity changes the kinetic energy also changes. So options 2, 3, and 4 are wrong.

Concept used:

A square of a number is obtained by multiplying the number itself.

Calculation:

⇒ 1 × 1 = 1

⇒ 2 × 2 = 4

⇒ 3 × 3 = 9

⇒ 4 × 4 = 16

⇒ 5 × 5 = 25

The bottles have equal capacity

For bottle 2, milk be 7b and water be 9b

⇒ 2c + c = y

⇒ c = y/3      …(iii)

⇒ Percentage of milk = (5a + 7b + 2c) × 100/(12a + 16b + 3c) …from (i), (ii) and (iii)

⇒ Percentage of milk = (5 × y/12 + 7 × y/16 + 2 × y/3) × 100/(y + y + y)

⇒ Percentage of milk = 50.7%

∴ the percentage of milk be 50.7%

Making the quantity in all bottles equal by making total quantity = 48 liters

Fore bottle-3

Total quantity of mixture = 48 × 3 = 144 liters

Total quantity of milk = 20 + 21 + 32 = 73 liters

questions.question: In triangle ABC, ∠ABC = 90°. BP is drawn perpendicular to AC. If ∠BAP = 30°, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠PBC?
questions.questionHtml: In triangle ABC, ∠ABC = 90°. BP is drawn perpendicular to AC. If ∠BAP = 30°, then what is the value (in degrees) of ∠PBC?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

In a right-angled triangle, the altitude drawn to the hypotenuse creates two smaller triangles that are similar to the original triangle.

A key property of this configuration is that the angle between the altitude and a leg is equal to the interior angle at the opposite vertex.

Specifically, in ▵ABC right-angled at B with altitude BP, ∠PBC = ∠BAP.

Given ∠BAP = 30°, it follows that ∠PBC = 30°.

∴ The correct answer is 30°.

Alternate Method

Given: In ▵ABC, ∠ABC = 90°, BP ⊥ AC, and ∠BAP = 30°.

Formula Used: Angle Sum Property of a triangle (sum of angles = 180°).

In ▵ABP:

⇒ ∠APB = 90° (Since BP ⊥ AC)

⇒ ∠BAP = 30° (Given)

⇒ ∠ABP = 180° − (∠APB + ∠BAP)

⇒ ∠ABP = 180° − (90° + 30°) = 60°

Now, considering the right angle at vertex B:

⇒ ∠ABC = 90°

⇒ ∠ABP + ∠PBC = 90°

⇒ 60° + ∠PBC = 90°

⇒ ∠PBC = 90° − 60° = 30°

∴ The correct answer is 30°.

Additional Information

Similarity in Right Triangles

The altitude to the hypotenuse of a right triangle divides it into two triangles that are similar to each other and to the original triangle (▵APB ∼ ▵BPC ∼ ▵ABC).

Geometric Mean Theorem

The length of the altitude BP is the geometric mean of the lengths of the segments of the hypotenuse: BP2 = AP × PC.

Angle Relationships

In this configuration, the angles are related as ∠ABP = ∠BCP and ∠PBC = ∠BAP.

questions.question: In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice. Sunita has written a story which fascinates everyone.
questions.questionHtml:
In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice. 

Sunita has written a story which fascinates everyone.

options.text: A story which has been written by Sunita fascinates every one.
options.html: A story which has been written by Sunita fascinates every one.

options.text: Everyone is fascinated by the story which has been written by Sunita.
options.html: Everyone is fascinated by the story which has been written by Sunita.

options.text: Every one fascinates the story which is written by Sunita.
options.html: Every one fascinates the story which is written by Sunita.

options.text: Story written by Sunita fascinates everyone.
options.html: Story written by Sunita fascinates everyone.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2'.
Key Points
  • The original sentence is in the active voice and needs to be converted to the passive voice.
  • In the passive voice, the object of the active sentence (a story) becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
  • The original action done by Sunita (writing the story) is now being described as an action that the story (now the subject) has undergone by Sunita.
  • The verb phrase "has written" becomes "has been written by" in the passive voice to indicate that the action was performed by Sunita.
  • The part of the sentence "which fascinates everyone" is correctly maintained as expressing the effect of the story, highlighting the correct transformation without changing the meaning.
Therefore, the correct answer is- 'Option 2'.
Additional Information
  •  Option 1 says, "A story which has been written by Sunita fascinates every one." This option, while passively constructed, rearranges the focus of the sentence awkwardly, making it slightly less direct in conveying who is fascinated by the story.
  • Option 3 states, "Every one fascinates the story which is written by Sunita." This option incorrectly suggests that everyone is doing the action of fascinating the story, which misrepresents the original sentence's meaning.
  • Option 4 suggests, "Story written by Sunita fascinates everyone." Although this option maintains the meaning and is in a passive construction, it lacks the passive voice marker ("has been written by") that clearly indicates the action performed on the subject (the story).
